observations.detail: GitHub check-run for the pushed branch head, read through the API

note: Every observation names the exact commit GitHub evaluated. The local head differs from the pushed head whenever this capture writes a follow-up evidence commit, so the newest run for this tree is reported in the pull request thread rather than asserted from a run of a different commit.
